To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

tocilizumabs efficacy in experimental allergic asthma depends on IL-6 transsignalling, and that high sIL-6 receptor levels in asthmatics may identify patients that would benefit from treatment with tocilizumab.

IL-6 trans-signalisation plays a critical role only in the development of mixed granulocytosis (neutrophil/eosinophil) airway inflammation, and tocilizumab has therapeutic potential only in this group of asthmatics.
tocilizumam is an effective treatment for allergic asthma in patients who have elevated levels of the soluble form of the IL-6 receptor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel personalised treatment for asthma.
the identification of novel therapeutic strategies that could be applied in the management of allergic asthma.
understanding the role of IL-6 in the pathogenesis of allergic diseases, and the potential of targeting the IL-6/sIL-6R axis for treatment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the IL-1β pathway is a promising new target for the treatment of asthma and that IL-1β blockade is a promising new treatment option for severe asthma, especially in those patients with high levels of the soluble IL-1R.
tocilizumabs is an effective treatment for asthma in a subgroup of patients with high airway sIl6r levels.
tocilizumub is a promising new drug to treat asthma, but only in patients with elevated sIL-6 levels in the airways.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IL-6 transsignaling is a key driver in the pathogenesis of allergic asthma and that IL-6 receptor blockade may be a new personalised treatment for allergic asthma.
we have identified a novel pathway in asthma, and that we have identified the first drug to treat this pathway.
tocilizumub is effective in a model of asthma that causes mixed granucolytic infiltration (neutrophilic and eosinophilic), but not in the eosinophilic model of asthma.
The main takeaway from our work is that

IL-6 trans-signalisation is a key mechanism of allergic inflammation in the airways and that tocilizumabe, an anti-IL-6 receptor antibody, is an effective therapy in a model of allergic airway inflammation.
tocilizumub has a potential therapeutic benefit in allergic asthma.
